title: Epoxy Grout and Glitter-Black
description:
Simply add your epoxy grout and glitter to your shopping cart to get the grout and sparkle colour you desire

IMPORTANT The Glitter is only compatible with Sparkzle Epoxy Grout. If any other grout is used the desired glitter sparkle effect will not work. You need to use Sparkzle Epoxy Grout only with the Glitter.

Coverage approx 5m2 Epoxy Grout & 1 Bag of 150g glitter

Add a new dimension to your wall and floor designs with Sparkzle Glitter Grout. You simply mix the glitter with our two part epoxy grout to produce the Sparkzle glistening look which complements a range of different tiles. You can choose from glitter in either silver or gold colours - which are available in 150g bags. Create an amazing look in kitchens and bathrooms with Sparkzle glitter grout which has a genuine wow factor.

Our high quality epoxy mortar is available in 2.5kg tubs. To bring the sparkle simply add the 150g glitter pack that is available Gold and Silver
Waterproof Grout
Sparkzle not only looks great but it has the quality to match. This waterproof grout is perfect for bathrooms and wet rooms. You will also find Sparkzle easy to clean and maintain in kitchens as it is highly resilient against mould, stains and acid. This two part epoxy grout is suitable for high traffic areas in both residential and commercial properties. Epoxy Grout is available in 2.5kg and you can select from a range of colours.
Glitter Grout for a Variety of Tiles
Tiling contractors, homeowners and interior designers love Sparkzle glitter grout as it is an all-round excellent choice for a vast range of tiling projects. This grout is also fast setting which means jobs can be finished in super quick time. Sparkzle is often selected for use with glittery quartz as these tiles have sparkly mirror pieces which reflect light emphatically. Sparkzle, however, is not used exclusively with quartz as it is also chosen to complement marble, granite and other varieties to stunning effect.
Coverage approx 5m2 Epoxy Grout & 1 Bag of 150g glitter

title: Diamond White Sparkly Quartz Tiles-300x300
description:
Diamond White Sparkly Quartz Tiles
These engineered white quartz tiles, made with 97% quartz with 1mm bevel edge, provide a standout appearance and highly durable covering in bathrooms and kitchens. Containing more mirror fleck per m2 than any other tile on the market, these sparkly quartz wall and floor tiles are a great option for contemporary layouts. Light bounces off Diamond White Quartz flooring to produce a glittery appearance. You can also make walls glisten by choosing these white sparkle tiles which are available in a range of sizes.

Low Maintenance and Durable White Polished Mirror Quartz
White quartz certainly has the substance to match its bling. This tile is notable for having an incredibly low moisture absorption rate making it easy to clean and maintain. As a result of the manufacturing process which involves fusing crushed resin with quartz, this tile is among the hardest wearing and most durable options for high traffic areas. These tiles are therefore perfect for busy public spaces, including the expansive interiors of airports and shopping centres.

Sparkly Diamond White Quartz Walls and Floors
Provide your walls and floors with a real wow factor by choosing these Sparkly Diamond White Quartz Tiles. For a classic look you can match them with our Midnight Black Quartz Tiles in your bathroom or kitchen. The use of quartz in outdoor areas, with under floor heating systems and within high thermal environments is at your own risk. These areas include conservatories and in close proximity to patio doors. Latex adhesive is not recommended for applying quartz to walls and floors.

IMPORTANT The Glitter is only compatible with Sparkzle Epoxy Grout. If any other grout is used the desired glitter sparkle effect will not work. You need to use Sparkzle Epoxy Grout only with the Glitter.

Coverage approx 5m2 Epoxy Grout & 1 Bag of 150g glitter

Add a new dimension to your wall and floor designs with Sparkzle Glitter Grout. You simply mix the glitter with our two part epoxy grout to produce the Sparkzle glistening look which complements a range of different tiles. You can choose from glitter in either silver or gold colours - which are available in 150g bags. Create an amazing look in kitchens and bathrooms with Sparkzle glitter grout which has a genuine wow factor.

Our high quality epoxy mortar is available in 2.5kg tubs. To bring the sparkle simply add the 150g glitter pack that is available Gold and Silver
Waterproof Grout
Sparkzle not only looks great but it has the quality to match. This waterproof grout is perfect for bathrooms and wet rooms. You will also find Sparkzle easy to clean and maintain in kitchens as it is highly resilient against mould, stains and acid. This two part epoxy grout is suitable for high traffic areas in both residential and commercial properties. Epoxy Grout is available in 2.5kg and you can select from a range of colours.
Glitter Grout for a Variety of Tiles
Tiling contractors, homeowners and interior designers love Sparkzle glitter grout as it is an all-round excellent choice for a vast range of tiling projects. This grout is also fast setting which means jobs can be finished in super quick time. Sparkzle is often selected for use with glittery quartz as these tiles have sparkly mirror pieces which reflect light emphatically. Sparkzle, however, is not used exclusively with quartz as it is also chosen to complement marble, granite and other varieties to stunning effect.

title: Fast Set Flexible 1 Part Adhesive Grey

breadcrumb.name: Fast Set Flexible 1 Part Adhesive Grey

description:
Our fast setting flexible adhesive is ideal for fixing wall and floor tiles in both interior and exterior areas. This easy to use adhesive offers premium quality fixing which complies with British and European standards with approx coverage 4m2 per bag.
Fastset Flexible Adhesive is:WaterproofCompatible with underfloor heatingSuitable for use with a variety of tiles, including; Porcelain, Quartz, Slate, Travertine, Quarry Granite ,Ceramic, Marble, Limestone and also wooden floors
How to use:Preparation:Before fixing, all surfaces must be clean, dry and strong enough to support the weight of the tiles and adhesive. The floor or wall to be tiled must be free from excessive or sudden movement and be securely fixed to the supports. If you are using underfloor heating then this must be embedded in a layer of adhesive and allowed to set prior to fixing tiles.
Fixing:This high strength adhesive is extremely easy to use. It is one part, which means no admix is required. You simply mix the adhesive with cold tap water to a smooth and creamy mixture, either by hand or with a slow mechanical mixing paddle. Mix only a sufficient amount which can be used within 40 minutes, then apply the adhesive to the floor using a notched trowel. The layer of adhesive should be between 3mm and 6mm when the tiles are applied. Also apply adhesive to the back of deep studded tiles to cover the studs. Ensure the adhesive is still moist when the tiles are pressed into place. Surplus adhesive should be cleaned as soon as possible from the tiles and joints. Once all the tiles are fixed, grout can be applied after three hours.
Instructions are given as a guideline only, for your specific project needs please follow full instructions given on the bag

title: Electric Underfloor Heating Mats
description:
Warm Floors UnderfootEnjoy our stylish and beautiful floor coverings in warmth and comfort with electrical underfloor heating mats from Tilesporcelain. Electric underfloor heating systems are 50% cheaper to buy and install in comparison to water under floor heating systems and are also more cost effective to run.
Heating KitsOur electric underfloor heating kits Include 1 programmable room digital thermostat and can be used with; porcelain, travertine, ceramic, granite, marble, limestone and slate.
Easily InstalledThis underfloor heating system will save you time and money. Labour costs are at a minimum as you can install these electric mats yourself. Anybody can install these electric mats; from the DIY novice to an experienced builder, it is a simple and time-saving task opposed to the installation of water heating systems. You will however require a qualified electrician to connect the system to the mains supply
Alternative Power RequirementsElectric underfloor heating appliances are available in UFH mats for 150w and 200w systems. Our innovative systems have a duel core cable with Teflon coating and sticky back adhesive strips which help to insulate your flooring.
Important
Due to the possible restriction of airflow which could lead to thermal blocking and a potential fire hazard, flat bottomed furniture must not be placed over areas in which these Electric Underfloor Heating Mats have been installed. Flat Bottomed Furniture includes mattresses and flat based units. Furthermore; bean bags, rugs, animal beds and any other item with a tog value which is greater than 2.5 must not be placed over these Electric Underfloor Heating Mats.
Underfloor heating mats consist of:

Heating cable attached to a fibreglass mesh scrim for easy installation.
The UFH Mats can simply be rolled out onto the surface area thus saving you time.
The UFH Mats have double sided tape on the underside so they can easily be fixed to any clean surface.
The UFH Mats have a twin conductor cable simplifying installation with a single 3m connection.
The UFH Mats are available in 2 standard power dissipations:

150 Watts/m2 mats are suitable for internal applications including kitchens and bathrooms
200 Watts/m2 mats are available for conservatory use or areas where high heat losses can occur.

Underfloor Insulation Boards:

The latest innovation of heat insulation consisting of Extruded Polyester (XPS)
Two different sized thicknesses 1200x600mm x 6mm or 10mm
Easy to roll out onto your surface area.
Easy to cut to suit your room
Waterproof
Thermal Conductivity W/mk 0.029
Can withstand loads of 30 tonne per m2
60% increase in home heat efficiency

Features

Approved to EN60335-2-96 as required by the 17th Edition Wiring Regulations (BS7671:2008)
Two heat outputs, 150W/m2 and 200W/m2
Quick installation, Simply roll out the mat and fix to the floor
Suitable for tile, stone, slate and marble floor finishes
Continuous metallic earth screen to ensure electrical safety
Low build height - Minimal floor height build up
Suitable for use in wet areas
EMC safe

Technical Data

Max Power Loading - 150W/m2 or 200W/m2
Diameter - 3.mm - 4.0mm
230V supply
Twin conductor heating cable with single 3m "cold tail" connection lead

Digital ThermostatsThe TP132 is a premium quality programmable thermostat that is ultra compact and provides precise control of the ambient temperature with a floor limit.Features include:

Compact Design - One of the smallest, most attractive designs on the market. Programme buttons are hidden behind facia doors to provide an attractive flush finish Intuitive Programming
Simple to set-up and programme - It has a large easy to read LED with intuitive programming icons

The TP132 series is available in 3 versions all 3450W @230V, 15A resistive. 50Hz with 4 wires/SPSTPolar White Finish - Classic colouring will suit all room environmentsThe TP132F and AF are supplied with a 3m floor sensor cable

title: Wide Joint Floor Grout (Grey)
description:
You simply mix this grey grout powder with water and apply between tile joints of 3mm-20mm for a sturdy and protective fixed floor application. Grey grout works impressively as part of the look of your tiled floor. For a darker contrast apply grey grout between light ivory or cream tiles. In contrast grey grout is equally well suited for a lighter shade between black tiles,approx coverage 7.5m2 per bag.
Premium quality one part flexible grout is easy to apply and suitable for grouting a variety of floor tiles including; Porcelain, Marble, Travertine, Limestone, Quartz, Ceramic, Granite and Slate. Our grout is waterproof making it perfect for shower areas and swimming pools. It is also compatible with underfloor heating. Wide Joint Floor Grout can be used in both internal and external areas.
Here’s how you use it:Ensure the tiles are firmly fixed and the joints are clean before grouting. Firstly, add the grout powder to cold clean tap water and mix into a smooth, slightly stiff consistency, which can be done by hand or with a mechanical mixing paddle. Mix only a sufficient amount which can be used within one hour. Work the grout into the joints to make sure they are completely filled.
Make sure you clean surplus grout from the tiles and joints as soon as possible as set grout will prove difficult to remove later. Allow 24 hours before walking on the surface. If you have installed an underfloor heating system it is recommended that you do not apply heat until two days after grouting your tiles.
Instructions are given as a guideline only, for your specific project needs please follow full instructions given on the bag

description:

category: Black And White Bathroom Floor Tiles
description:
Creating a Timeless Aesthetic with Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles
Are you looking for a stylish and durable flooring option for your home? Consider Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles, which offer the classic look of marble with the practicality of porcelain. These tiles are made to withstand heavy foot traffic, making them perfect for any room in your home. Plus, their black and white pattern creates a timeless and elegant aesthetic.

Luxury Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles Kitchen & Bathroom Designs
When it comes to home decor, your flooring plays a major role in setting the tone for any space. Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles can help you achieve a luxury feel to your kitchen and bathroom designs that will last for years. Featuring an intricate yet minimalistic design, this tile can be used on walls and floors to add some sophistication to your home interiors. The durability of porcelain also means that these tiles are perfect for high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms where they will withstand wear and tear over time.

The beauty and benefits of using porcelain tiles for your home décor
Porcelain tiles are not only beautiful, but they also come with a host of benefits that make them a great choice for your home décor. One of the biggest advantages of porcelain is its durability. These tiles are made from a denser clay than traditional ceramic tiles, making them less susceptible to chipping and cracking. They are also highly resistant to moisture, which makes them perfect for use in kitchens and bathrooms where spills and splashes are common. In addition, porcelain tiles are easy to clean and maintain, so you can enjoy their timeless aesthetic without worrying about extensive upkeep.

Why choose Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles over natural marble for a timeless look?
While natural marble has a stunning luxury look, it can come with significant downsides like maintenance costs and susceptibility to scratches, stains, and chips over time. Jazz Black Marble Effect Porcelain Tiles offer an ideal alternative that guarantee the quality and longevity of natural marble, without the high cost of upkeep. Its timeless color pattern creates a luxurious aesthetic that fit any space and style without sacrificing its durability or low-maintenance properties. Whether you’re decorating your living room or bathroom, these tiles are sure to elevate your home décor with their elegance and practicality.

Premium Quartz Tiles
Engineered quartz from Tilesporcelain has a low moisture absorption rate making them suitable for shower areas. If you choose them for your home you’ll soon discover they are extremely low maintenance. Furthermore, the hard wearing quality ensures they can be installed in high traffic areas, thus explaining why they are regularly chosen for shops and hotels. This is a premium option but don’t just take our word for it, order a sample for a closer look. Quartz is resin based and it’s therefore entirely at your own risk should you use them with under floor heating systems or within environments which are exposed to high thermal conditions, including conservatories, sunrooms, near glass patio doors and outdoor areas. We recommend that latex adhesive is not used for tiling quartz.

title: Zultanite Grey Quartz 300x300
description:
Zultanite Grey Sparkly Quartz Tiles
Highly polished Zultanite grey quartz with sparkly mirror pieces from Tilesporcelain are a contemporary option for walls and floors. Displaying a standout appearance emphasised by a highly polished finish these tiles work effectively as part of modern bathroom and kitchen interiors. A lighter coloured grout is regularly matched with these tiles. Available in a range of sizes, you can acquire the dimensions which best suit the layout of your room. This premium quality tile has a 97% quartz content.

Transform Walls and Floors with Grey Quartz Tiles
If you would like to provide your interior with a standout appearance these grey quartz tiles are an excellent choice and they also have a 1mm bevelled edge. They have a surface covered in sparkly mirror flecks which can transform bathroom and kitchen layouts. We highly recommend these grey quartz tiles if you are looking to provide walls and floors with a unique modern style.

Low Maintenance Quartz
Requiring only straightforward cleaning and maintenance, grey quartz are a practical choice. Some of the main features include an extremely low moisture absorption rate and a high resilience against stains and scratches. These tiles are therefore suitable for areas which experience high levels of foot traffic like shopping centres and airports. By ordering a sample of the Zultanite grey quartz tile you can see the amazing quality for yourself. Quartz is resin based and therefore any use as part of conservatory designs, in close proximity to patio doors, outdoor areas, within high thermal environments or with under floor heating is entirely at your own risk. Ensure the adhesive used when fitting quartz does not comprise of a latex base.
